name: Hunter Tundra Touched
body:
Whether by birth, blood, or faith, winter’s essence permeates the soul of a tundra touched, imbuing the tundra touched with frosty powers and protection against the cold.

Many tundra touched are raised in the frigid lands of the far north, while others have a hint of giant blood coursing through their veins, and a favored few are gifted their abilities as a reward for loyal obedience to a higher power.

A tundra touched has the following class features.

Frozen Spells

In addition to spells gained by a tundra touched as she gains levels, each tundra touched also automatically adds the following spells to her spells known each time she gains the ability to cast a new spell level. These bonus spells do not count against her total allotment of known spells.

ray of frost (0), icicle dagger (1st), frost fall (2nd), elemental aura (cold) (3rd), ice storm (4th), cone of cold (5th), freezing sphere (6th).

This alters spellcasting and replaces the summon nature’s ally spells gained by other hunters.

Cold Conduit

At 1st level, a tundra touched gains one additional spell slot per day per spell level she is capable of casting which must be filled with a frozen spell. Additionally, the save DC to resist the frozen spells of a tundra touched is increased by +1.

This replaces nature training, wild empathy and all bonus tricks.

Cold Comfort (Su)

At 3rd level, a tundra touched gains the constant benefit of endure elements against cold temperatures, and gains cold resistance equal to her tundra touched level. In addition, three times per day, as an immediate action in response to incurring fire damage, a tundra touched can reduce the amount of fire damage sustained by 1/2 (after any saving throws are made).

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 3rd level.

Companion Tactics (Ex)

A tundra touched shares her cold resistance and glacial grace ability with her animal companion as long as they are within 100 feet of each other.

This replaces hunter tactics.

Glacial Grace (Ex)

At 5th level, icy surfaces and deep snow no longer hinder the movement of a tundra touched. A tundra touched can move across icy surfaces without penalty, never needs to make Acrobatic checks to run or charge on ice, and does not expend additional squares of movement to move through heavy snow. Furthermore, a tundra touched can see through falling snow and sleet without taking penalties to her Perception checks.

This replaces woodland stride.

Snow Drift (Su)

At 6th level, once per day, as a swift action, a tundra touched can cause a pile of heavy snow to amass in a 10 foot radius around herself, which lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 her tundra touched level, after which time it promptly melts away. The snow counts as difficult terrain (though it does not hinder the tundra touched) and clings to creatures for 1 round after leaving the affected area. The clinging snow continues to reduce the affected creature’s speed as though it was traveling through difficult terrain.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 6th level.

Wintry Weapon (Su)

At 9th level, as a move action, a tundra touched can imbue any weapon she is utilizing with the frost special weapon quality for a number of rounds per day equal to 1/2 her tundra touched level. These rounds do not need to be used consecutively. This ability can not be used on a weapon that already has the flaming special weapon quality. If the weapon already has the frost ability, it instead gains the icy burst special weapon quality.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 9th level.

Frozen Stiff (Su)

At 12th level, once per day, when a tundra touched casts a spell with the cold descriptor, she can cause all creatures taking cold damage from her spell to become paralyzed for a number of rounds equal to her Wisdom modifier.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 12th level.

Frigid Breath (Su)

At 15th level, once per day, as a standard action, a tundra touched can exhale a cloud of frigid air in a 30-foot cone that deals 1d6 points of cold damage for every 3 tundra touched levels and staggers affected creatures for 3 rounds. A successful Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 tundra touched level + her Wisdom modifier) halves the damage and negates the staggered effect.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 15th level.

Piercing Icicles (Su)

At 18th level, once per day, as a free action, a tundra touched can cause razor sharp icicles to protrude from her body granting a +4 natural armor bonus, lasting a number of rounds equal to her Wisdom modifier. While piercing icicles is in effect, any creature successfully attacking a tundra touched with a natural or non-reach melee weapon suffers 2d6 points of piercing damage and 2d6 cold damage and must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 tundra touched level + her Wisdom modifier) or become staggered for 1 round.

This replaces the teamwork feat gained at 18th level.
